subject.title: Proposal: safer self-update with pre-update backup + health check + auto-rollback/restore

question: Should OpenClaw core own an integrated opt-in safe-update transaction that snapshots state, runs real post-update checks, and restores or rolls back on failure?
rationale: The missing work defines updater product scope, secret handling, restore semantics, retention policy, and live smoke-check criteria across core state and plugins rather than a narrow code defect.

options.title: Sponsor Core Safe Update
options.body: Define a default-off core updater mode and split implementation into reviewed pieces for snapshots, retention, health/smoke checks, and restore/rollback policy.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Tracks
options.body: Use the open backup/restore, scanner, auto-update, and external-updater issues as the implementation tracks while leaving this issue as an umbrella reference.

options.title: Keep Outside Core
options.body: Document community automation and manual recovery flows while declining automatic restore/rollback until updater architecture changes.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Core Safe Update
recommendation.body: Define a default-off core updater mode and split implementation into reviewed pieces for snapshots, retention, health/smoke checks, and restore/rollback policy.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest observed connection across the prior product review and the core auto-updater history.
